<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Safe Elements](/Feats.aspx?ID=4190) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 22

</column>

---

Elements are wild and dangerous, but you've found ways to reduce their risk. When you [Channel Elements](/Actions.aspx?ID=2124) or use a [stance](/Traits.aspx?ID=152) [impulse](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) that affects your kinetic aura, you can designate a number of creatures up to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 creature). Choose whether they are immune to the benefits of your kinetic aura or immune to its damage and drawbacks. You don't have to be able to see a creature to designate it, nor does it need to be in your kinetic aura, but you can't designate a creature that's [unnoticed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=41) by you.

 In addition, you gain the Pacifying Infusion action.

 **Pacifying Infusion** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([infusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=503)) If your next action is an impulse, it gains the [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) trait. If it has an area, you can exclude creatures you've designated with Safe Elements from its effects.
name: Safe Elements
